prompt: data/catalog.json is an 8 MB JSON file stored on a single line (minified), so printing it or opening it in an editor will flood your context. It lists stores, each store has sections, and each section has items with a sku and a price. In store `store-0027`, in the section named `frozen`, change the price of the item with sku `SKU-4411` to 24.99. The same sku also appears in many other sections and stores; those must not change. Everything else in the file must stay exactly as it is and the file must remain valid JSON. Use a script (node or python) to make the edit instead of reading the file.
